model_description: Oral absorption PBPK model with hepatic glucuronidation and sulfation metabolism and multi-tissue distribution.
assignment_notes: Compound identified as Bisphenol A (MW 228.29 g/mol) matching extracted molecular weight. Species set to human per paper scope. Model type 2 selected because available data include hepatic Vmax/Km for Phase II metabolism (enabling intrinsic clearance calculation), tissue partition coefficients (Kp), gastric emptying rate constant (GEC) for oral absorption, and half-life for elimination kinetics. These parameters support a mechanistic oral absorption model with hepatic metabolism and tissue distribution. BW = 70 kg standard adult; QCC = 1.3 L/h/kg standard cardiac output per kg; Qliver = 20% of cardiac output; Vliver = 2.5% BW; V_plasma = 4.5% BW. Kp_liver derived as exp(0.73) = 2.08 from extracted log-normal ln-mean. CL_hep calculated via well-stirred model: total intrinsic CL_int = (707537/45800) + (11657/10100) approx 16.6 L/h/kg; with liver blood flow 1.287 L/h/kg, CL_hep approx 83 L/h for 70 kg. k_a set to GEC (3.5 hr⁻¹) as oral absorption rate constant. Oral dose 100 μg/kg bw/day converted to 0.1 mg/kg. Simulation end time 24 h covers one exposure day relative to half-life ~4 h.
